standing.watch: The records leave several matters unresolved. The funding and valuation fields for both DeepSeek AI and High-Flyer are blank, so no financial scale is recorded. The difference between the February 2016 co-founding date in the profile and the 2015 founding date for High-Flyer in the company record is not explained. The profile notes that High-Flyer holds the controlling stake in DeepSeek and that Liang holds a minority personal stake, according to Chinese corporate registry reporting, but no further ownership details are given. The DeepSeek-R1 paper is recorded as published in Nature and posted to arXiv in January 2025, and no later research, product, or corporate event is listed. No pending case, planned listing, or dispute appears in the records. What comes next is therefore not specified beyond these open items.
standing.record: The site's records connect Liang to two companies, DeepSeek AI and High-Flyer. DeepSeek AI is listed as a research lab in Hangzhou, founded in 2023, with no funding or valuation recorded. High-Flyer is listed as a startup in Hangzhou, China, founded in 2015, also with no funding or valuation recorded. The profile says Liang built a quantitative hedge fund before turning its computing infrastructure toward frontier AI research, then released a reasoning model that matched top Western systems at a fraction of their reported training cost. It also says he co-founded High-Flyer in February 2016, while the company record gives a 2015 founding date. The pattern in these records is a founder who moved from quantitative finance into AI research, with corporate control of DeepSeek held through High-Flyer and a minority personal stake for Liang. No lawsuits or news stories are supplied in the records.
standing.standing: Liang Wenfeng is founder and CEO of DeepSeek, an AI research company based in Hangzhou, China, according to the profile. He also co-founded the quantitative hedge fund High-Flyer in February 2016 with two Zhejiang University classmates. High-Flyer holds the controlling stake in DeepSeek, while Liang holds a minority personal stake, according to Chinese corporate registry reporting. He is the corresponding author on the DeepSeek-R1 paper published in Nature and posted to arXiv in January 2025. The records list DeepSeek AI as founded in 2023 and High-Flyer as founded in 2015, with no funding or valuation figures shown. That is the extent of what the site records about his current position and influence.

timeline.event: Earns bachelor's and master's degrees in electronic and information engineering from Zhejiang University
timeline.impact: Technical foundation in signal processing and machine learning

timeline.event: Co-founds the quantitative hedge fund High-Flyer with two university classmates
timeline.impact: Builds the trading and computing operation that would later fund DeepSeek

timeline.event: High-Flyer builds the Fire-Flyer I and Fire-Flyer II GPU clusters for deep learning research
timeline.impact: Creates in-house compute infrastructure later redirected to AI model training

timeline.event: Founds DeepSeek as an AI research company funded by High-Flyer
timeline.impact: Moves from quantitative trading into frontier AI model development

timeline.event: DeepSeek releases the R1 reasoning model, later published as a peer-reviewed paper in Nature with Liang as corresponding author
timeline.impact: Model draws international attention to open-weight reasoning models and reported training efficiency

quick_facts: Founder and CEO of DeepSeek, an AI research company based in Hangzhou, China
Co-founded the quantitative hedge fund High-Flyer in February 2016 with two Zhejiang University classmates
Holds a bachelor's degree in Electronic Information Engineering (2007) and a master's degree in Information and Communication Engineering (2010), both from Zhejiang University
Corresponding author on the DeepSeek-R1 paper published in Nature and posted to arXiv in January 2025
High-Flyer holds the controlling stake in DeepSeek, with Liang holding a minority personal stake, according to Chinese corporate registry reporting

achievements.title: Co-founding High-Flyer (2016)
achievements.impact: Built a quantitative hedge fund that developed its own AI training infrastructure, including the Fire-Flyer I (2019) and Fire-Flyer II (2021) computing clusters.

achievements.title: Founding DeepSeek (2023)
achievements.impact: Established an AI research lab funded by High-Flyer to pursue frontier large language model research after venture capital investors passed on the project.

achievements.title: DeepSeek-R1 release (January 2025)
achievements.impact: Released an open-weight reasoning model trained with reinforcement learning that reportedly matched leading closed models on math, coding and reasoning benchmarks, drawing global attention to its training cost.
